feature1.prompt: The issue is that updating an array passed as the xy parameter to annotate results in unexpected updates to the annotation. In the current behavior, when an array used for the xy kwarg in an annotation with arrows is modified after the annotation is created, the arrow positions change. The expected behavior is that the annotation remains unchanged even if the original array is updated. This feature should ensure that the annotation system isolates its internal state from external mutations of the input array.
